_comment: Capability comparison shown on the Features & roadmap page. RE-ISSUED FROM THE CORPUS by scripts/sync-capability-comparison.mjs. Do not edit this file by hand: the corpus is ConductionNL/market-intelligence, procest/_ledger/parity-ledger.html, and every id, capability text and rating here comes from it. A hand edit is what happened on 2026-09-10, and it put 104 rows on this page that no corpus artefact held, under ids the corpus used for other questions. tests/vitest/capabilityComparison.spec.js now fails when the id set here differs from capabilityComparison.corpus-ids.json. `capabilities` are the 225 ROWS: every column has been read against each of them, and `comparedOn` is the date the first four were read. It moves only when all four are read again. A column added later carries its own `readOn` and `columnAddedOn`, because moving `comparedOn` to cover it would make the reading-date sentence false for the four it already covers. A row added by a later round carries its own `addedOn` and rates every competitor `unknown`, because a guess in someone else's column is worse than an empty cell, and `rowsAddedOn` is the most recent of those dates. `pending` are the 146 PROPOSALS: questions raised against one product, not yet read against the rest. Every competitor cell on them is `unknown` and our own is rated, because we can always read our own code. They are not rows and they are not counted in any tally. A proposal becomes a row when every column has been read for it, and its id is assigned at that moment, centrally, in the corpus. Our OWN column is corrected between rounds, because a rating that says we lack something we shipped is the one error on this page a reader cannot check for themselves. The competitor columns are NOT corrected that way: we would be re-reading someone else's product without saying so, and the honest fix for those is a new round with a new comparedOn. Every correction and every added row is in `_rerated` with its date and its reason, and `reratedOn` carries the latest.

_rerated.reason: Plan follow-up is a header action on the case page, swept by a background job. A repeating series still is not, so this is partial and not yes.
A case carries tags, edited in the Tags sidebar tab and filtered on the Cases list.
Copy case is a header action on the case page, backed by CaseCopyService.
A document carries keywords, shown as chips on its row and offered as a filter over the case file.
A protected person is marked as protected, their number is masked, and revealing it writes an audit row.
Case types group into folders by category. Attributes and templates do not, so this is partial and not yes.
Round 3 row. Two reports of the same nuisance on two channels is routine front-office work. We relate cases, we never collapse them, and a late reply to the closed one reaches nobody.
Round 3 row. Nothing on our intake path looks for a case that already exists.
Round 3 row, narrowed. The proposal also asked whether the pause reason is stored, which row 2.11 already asks. What is left is the chasing, and nothing in the app re-asks.

Round 3 row. CaseRelationService types a link as vervolg, subject or bijdrage and writes it on both cases, but the mirror carries the same name, so no link means blocks on one side and blocked by on the other.
Round 3 row, refiled from access-and-privacy to case-core: a lock is concurrency, not access control. Two handlers can overwrite each other on a case and neither is told.
Round 3 row. Our bulk actions each do one thing, and none of them decides where the handler lands afterwards.
Round 3 row. One flag per entry is what makes a single timeline safe to show an applicant. Row 6.4 is already no for the timeline, so the flag was never in question.
Round 3 row, refiled from integrations to communication. We score no and we are content with it: a municipality owes an applicant an outcome, not a rating request.
Round 3 row. Article 1 of the Algemene termijnenwet extends a term that ends on a Saturday, Sunday or recognised holiday. We add the days and stop.

Round 3 row. Round 3 read five private calendars and rated us no. WorkingDayCalculator has since landed and all five callers use it, so the single source of truth exists. Nobody can edit a holiday without a release, so this is partial and not yes.
Round 3 row, and one we lead on. DeadlinePauseService moves the end date out and pulls back the unused part when the applicant answers early, which is what Awb 4:15 asks for.

Round 3 row. DeadlineEscalationService widens from handler to teamleader to manager at 14, 7, 2 and 0 days. The ladder is a constant in code and not yet administered, which is a refinement rather than a gap.
Round 3 row. TermijnService stores both end dates as a date. A Dutch term expires at the close of a day, so storing a timestamp would be wrong here.
Round 3 row. Our threshold alerts sit on complaint analytics, not on a saved search.

Round 3 row. Round 3 rated us no and missed the Hours booked tile, which now books hours and runs a timer against the case. The hours live in humaniq and there is no rate or cost model, so this is partial and not yes.
Round 3 row. We hide actions and widgets on a field value, and field permissions exist per role, but no rule combines the two and none of it makes a field mandatory.
Round 3 row. Answers reused across cases are most of what a contact centre does, and we have no place to keep them.
Round 3 row. Row 13.12 covers mandates and deputies as a delegation of rights. This asks whether a case assigned to someone on leave shows up on anybody's list, and it does not.
Round 3 row. A favourite is navigation and row 2.19 already asks about it. A watch is a subscription, and a jurist following a sensitive case has no way to ask for one.

Corrected 2026-09-14 from the case-type depth study (`procest/_round4/discovery/casetype-configurability.md`): `statusType.colour` is a twelve-value NL Design System enum and `StatusesTab.vue:47` renders the swatch.

Corrected 2026-09-14 from the case-type depth study (`procest/_round4/discovery/casetype-configurability.md`): `statusType.checklist[]` carries title and required, `StatusChecklistGuard` enforces it, `StatusTypeForm.vue:118` authors it.

`lib/Controller/CaseDefinitionController.php` (export, import, validate, copy), `lib/Service/CaseDefinitionExportService.php`. Corrected 2026-09-14 from the case-type depth study (`procest/_round4/discovery/casetype-configurability.md`): the export service is a placeholder behind live routes.

`caseType.intakeFormRef` binds a form to a case type, `lib/Service/FormsIntakeService.php` turns a submission into a clocked case over the `forms` channel, and `FormSubmittedListener` is registered in `CrossAppListenerRegistrar` behind a class check. Shipped by dossiq#2927. The citizen-facing portal page is portaliq's per ADR-046 and buildiq authors the form.

`ContactDetail` and `OrganisationDetail` each carry a `new-case-for-contact` header action, an open-form on `case` with the requester prefilled, beside `log-contact`. So a handler starts a case from the person or the company in front of them.

`lib/Service/Email/UnmatchedMailIntake.php` opens a case from a mail the shared mailbox cannot place, once an administrator names a fallback case type, and `CaseEmailMatchJob` links new mail per opted-in user. `mailObjectTemplate` on `case` and on `complaint` gives the start-a-case button inside Nextcloud Mail. dossiq holds no IMAP credential of its own.

`case.identifier` declares `x-openregister-generated` with the sequence `case`, the format `{year}-{seq:4}` and a yearly reset, and `complaint.complaintNumber` carries its own counter. A number supplied by hand pushes the counter past it. `ComplaintService::generateComplaintNumber` is retired.

`case.assignedGroup` is a Team field on the case, `$ref` to `organisatieRol` and facetable, used seven times in `src/manifest.json`, beside the role types the mandate matrix reads. It is described as assignment and not as permission, which is the distinction the row asks about.

POST `/api/case/{caseId}/reopen` (`appinfo/routes.php:443`) runs `CaseLifecycleController::reopen`, guarded by the reopen authority, and the act sits in the Lifecycle acts menu on the case. That menu merges the available transitions, the lifecycle and the acts, and shows a refused act disabled with its reason.

Case objects have a page at `/case-objects`, a menu entry, a folder sidebar grouped on object type and a `case-objects` tab on the case. The tab's Object and Object status columns are lenses resolved on every read, so it shows what the object says now rather than what somebody typed when they linked it.

The case page carries a favourite star over openregister's favourite endpoints, rendered from `@self.favourite` so it makes no call until pressed. Favourites and Recently opened are lenses on the Cases list, and both have a tile on the Dashboard. Consumer half of openregister#3766, merged as dossiq#2875.

A flow ask step takes a form through the six flat keys `TaskFormReader::fromConfig()` reads (`lib/Flow/DossiqAskPersonNode.php:141,394`), beside the status transition path that already carried one. Both ways of raising a task can now ask for fields, and a required field left blank is refused in OpenRegister's own wording. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3086 (6a1ab145).

A Start header action on the case, gated on the materialised `hasStartableFlows`, opens `src/dialogs/CaseStartFlowDialog.vue`. That reads GET `/apps/dossiq/api/case/{id}/startable-flows` and runs the chosen flow on this case. Sub-cases come from `lib/Flow/DossiqTxCreateSubCaseNode.php`.

Document properties on the case Files leaf opens decidiq's approval chain: `src/manifest.json:2317` names the row action, `src/registry.js:651` resolves the dialog, and `src/modals/DocumentMetadataDialog.vue:152` renders `ApprovalChainLeafTab` over the leaf id `decidiq-approval-chain`. So a handler approves or rejects a document from the case, and the list carries an Approval column. The chain itself is decidiq's and needs that app installed. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3083 (19b334fb).

The `case-files` widget on the case renders the library's files browser over the case's own object folder: breadcrumbs from the root down, navigation into subfolders, and New folder from the file menu. The ZGW Documents tab it replaced was retired on 2026-09-13, which is what the old note described.

The same files browser binds dragover and drop on its root and PUTs the dropped files over DAV, beside the New menu's upload entry. `lib/Service/Zaakdossier/DossierUploadHandler.php` still serves the ZGW upload path.

The `case-parties` widget in the People tab lists everyone involved in the case, grouped by role type, with avatar, email, validity window and note, and a picker over users and contacts. `SyncCaseRoleVocabulary` writes the instance's role types and `PersonLinkListener` projects each link onto a `role` record, so the resolver and the mandate matrix read what they always read.

`Contacts` and `Organisations` are index pages and `ContactDetail` and `OrganisationDetail` are detail pages over `brpPerson` and `kvkCompany`. The three open tasks on `contacts-domain` are all moved or blocked in another app, none of them this capability.

`ContactDetail` and `OrganisationDetail` each carry four panels: the card, the cases, the contact moments and `contact-documents` (`src/manifest.json:7053,7145,7344,7436`). The documents panel reads the `dispatch` join, so direction is a row value rather than a guess. Cases, documents and communication are all on both pages now. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3083 (19b334fb).

The `case-timeline-panel` tab is one chronological read of every note, logged call, inbound and outbound message and acknowledgement of receipt on the case, from openregister's timeline. `lib/Service/Timeline/TimelineKinds.php` enumerates the kinds, portal messages included. The audit sidebar keeps the change history, deliberately apart.

`MailIntakeLogView` lists every message the shared mailbox processed with the verdict that decided it, and each row offers File on case. That opens `MailIntakeFileOnCaseDialog` onto POST `/api/mail-intake/log/{entryId}/file-on-case` (`appinfo/routes.php:787`), guarded per case, so a handler files a message on a case they pick and the override stays traceable. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3079 (fbdadc4f).

Send digital post is a header action on the case (`src/manifest.json:3347`) and opens `BerichtenboxComposeDialog` over `IntegriqAdapter`, the default binding in `SubstitutableAdapterRegistrar`. integriq binds three providers for real: `lib/Service/DigitalPost/BerichtenboxProvider.php`, `PostexProvider.php` and `LogDigitalPostProvider.php`, each over the shared gateway transport. A send on an unset source is refused with the key named rather than simulated. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3081 (226b7e0b).

Read as a message is a row action on every file in the case Files leaf and posts the file to the saved-mail endpoint, which is guarded, capped at twenty megabytes and covered by its own PHP suite. dossiq also answers integriq's `MessageReceivedEvent` through `MessageReceivedListener`, replying linked, created or declined and never a silent decline. integriq reads the bytes, so a `.msg` renamed `.eml` still parses as what it is. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3079 (fbdadc4f).

`lib/Service/Conversation/CaseConversationService.php` starts a Talk conversation from any case through `OCP\Talk\IBroker` and records the moment, who joined and how long it lasted, and `CaseConversationsPanel.vue` renders it in the Communication tab. The messages said in the room are not pulled in: what a conversation produced is filed by hand as a case document. Raised from no to partial rather than to yes, because capture of the chat itself is the half that is missing.

`NotePush` pushes a case note over the ZGW adapter and reports a timeline write it lost instead of letting it read as written, which was the defect the closing PR fixed. Every note in the case notes tab now carries a `Send to the neighbouring register` action, so a handler reaches the push from the page (dossiq#3116, fc7fc1bc8, on the `noteActions` seam nextcloud-vue 2.56.0 grew for it). Held at partial for what is left: this is a deliberate act on one note rather than a sync, because OpenRegister dispatches no note-saved event dossiq could listen for, and the reserved informatieobjecttype is still undecided, so an instance that has not set `note_informatieobjecttype` gets a refusal naming the key. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3086 (6a1ab145).

`CaseTypeFieldFilters.vue` sits in the Cases actions bar and compiles openregister `_related[caseProperty][case][…]` blocks, handing them to the list through `sidebarState.onFilterChange` rather than leaving them on the route, where `resolveQueryFilters()` dropped every underscore key. SCANNED 2026-09-19 (pack c, verdict `sibling-has`): held and shipped by openregister, which dossiq consumes; satisfied, and not dossiq's code. Evidence: _ledger/gap-scan/c.json

All five dashboards declare `userLayout` with `appId` and `pageId`, so each reader keeps their own arrangement; `userLayout` alone stored nothing, because `loadUserLayout()` returns early without an app id. The Dashboard carries five count tiles, two charts and three object tables, reading `/apps/dossiq/api/dashboard/kpis` off `lib/Controller/KpiController.php`, and offers user widgets a reader can add. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3085 (87ec6952).

Export is a header action on the case type that downloads a zip (`src/manifest.json:6588`) and Import is a dialog that takes a file, because an api-call sends JSON and cannot. `CaseDefinitionExportService::exportComponent()` reads the register now instead of returning the fixed empty shape it used to. `CaseDefinitionPortabilityTest` is a round trip that asserts the written objects rather than a success status. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3084 (1c85c2a5).

The Cases list shows the columns, order and search fields a case type declares in its own `x-index` block, declared as a property of `caseType` in `lib/Settings/register.d/39-case-type-list-layout.json` and read back from the pinned library with a mutation. Three seeded case types carry one. CaseTypeDetail carries a `Columns in the case list` data widget whose scoped edit dialog opens a form for `x-index` and nothing else, so an administrator sets a case type's columns inside the app rather than on the record (dossiq#3112, a7118ddf1). Held at partial for what is left: an object property renders as a JSON editor, so the block is typed rather than picked from the columns the Cases page declares, and `#Tasks` cannot carry one at all. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3085 (87ec6952).

`CaseTypeTranslationsWidget` is a widget on the case type page (`src/manifest.json:6509,6573`): a chip per declared language, a tab per language and one PATCH per edited label. The mark reaches the engine now, since dossiq spelled it `x-translatable` and OpenRegister reads `translatable`. Every marked label declares its source language and the register declares `["nl", "en"]`, so a changed Dutch label can stale its translations. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3084 (1c85c2a5).

`caseType.parentCaseType` is declared, and `lib/Service/CaseTypeResolver.php` implements it: `chainFor()`, `effectiveCaseType()`, `statusTypesFor()`, `resultTypesFor()` and `propertyDefinitionsFor()` resolve a child's inheritance at read time. A child declares only what differs, a chain that returns to itself is refused on save and the chain is at most three deep. Covered by `tests/e2e/case-type-parent-chain.spec.ts`.

CORRECTED 09-19: caseType has carried legalBasis, personalDataCategories, lawfulPurposeRetention and verwerkingsactiviteit since case-type-authoring-extras. SCANNED 2026-09-19 (pack d, verdict `have`): dossiq has this itself now and the note above predates the merged work. Evidence: _ledger/gap-scan/d.json

The Knowledge tab on a case (`src/manifest.json:2933`) holds the work instruction the case type names once, shown on every case of that type, and the Collectives pages linked to this case. dossiq stores no article text: Collectives owns the page and a collective is scoped to a Nextcloud team, which is the group `roleType.ncGroupId` already names. A reader who may not read a page does not read it through the case. xwiki was rejected with evidence: it never resolves on a dossiq page. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3083 (19b334fb).

Send digital post on the case opens `BerichtenboxComposeDialog` over `IntegriqAdapter`, which `SubstitutableAdapterRegistrar` binds by default, and integriq's Berichtenbox provider carries the send. The mock no longer pretends: an unset `digital_post_source` is refused with the key named, and the integrations page stopped reporting a mock that was not answering. Closed 2026-09-20 by dossiq#3081 (226b7e0b).

`lib/Settings/register.d/62-handler-vervanging.json` records an absence period with its absentee, its substitute, its dates, its scope and its reason, verlof, ziekte or anders. `src/views/admin/SubstitutionAdmin.vue` is a page with a menu entry, and `src/views/MyWorkCards.vue` shows the work an active substitution routes in, above the reader's own, behind a toggle. pending.name: Is a status transition guarded by role and by condition, per case type.
pending.dossiqNote: Rated from a read-only read of the source. `StatusTransitionService::assertTransitionAllowed` (`lib/Service/StatusTransitionService.php:457-490`) checks the from-status, then the transition's frozen group list, then every guard the case type's spec declares (`GuardRegistry::evaluateAll`), and throws `GuardFailedException` naming the failed guards: role and condition, per case type. Helpdesk enforces both through the framework's Workflow, measured: an Agent on a Medium ticket and an Agent Manager on the same ticket both got 417 *Workflow State transition not allowed from Open to Resolved*, and the manager on a High ticket got 200; the refusal does not say which half failed. RT is `partial`, by role and not by condition: a right per `from -> to` edge, granted per queue, with one hard-coded condition, unresolved dependencies. Rows 2.7, 3.2 and 13.2 each hold a third of the question and none holds it.

pending.name: When a configuration object in use is removed or disabled, does the product refuse, and does it name what it would strand.
pending.dossiqNote: Rated from the source: deleting a case type is blocked with the count (`lib/Service/ZgwZtcRulesService.php:760-769`, *Cannot delete case type: N active case(s) still use this type*) and deprecating the last published workflow definition is refused while open cases depend on it (`lib/Controller/WorkflowDefinitionController.php:94-100`); whether a status removed from a case type strands cases is not settled by those two files. Helpdesk is the best answer in the corpus because it counts the tickets and says what happens to them, measured five ways: *1 open tickets use priority High. They lose this SLA the next time they are updated.* RT is `partial`: a lifecycle a queue uses cannot be deleted and the queue is named, and a status removed from a graph strands tickets silently, with no count anywhere. Row 11.18's health page never sees this problem, because each change is valid on its own.

pending.name: At intake, does the product tell the requester when the clock starts, from the calendar.
pending.dossiqNote: From a grep: `WorkingDayCalculator` computes the term and the movable holidays and nothing at intake tells the citizen when it starts; `outside.?(working|business).?hours|buiten kantoor` over `lib src` returns 0, and the nearest is the confirmation with the case number. Helpdesk stamps `raised_outside_working_hours` on create and the portal banner returned *Thanks for reaching out. This ticket was created outside our working hours. You can expect the next response by Tuesday, 15 Sep.*, which is `response_by` as a day, the deadline rather than the first working minute. RT is `partial`: the engine sets `Starts` to the first business minute and the shipped autoreply template carries no date. Numbered 8.21 because batch 8 was publishing 8.20 while this was drafted.

pending.name: Can the intake form be embedded on the municipality's own website, and does a submission arrive as a case.
pending.dossiqNote: From a grep: `iframe|embed|widget.js|postMessage` over `lib/ src/` returns UUID and EXIF matches only, and the one public intake endpoint is `lib/Controller/DSOIntakeController.php` (`#[PublicPage]`), which receives DSO submissions from the Omgevingsloket and not a form on the municipality's site. The portal move to portaliq is where this would land. Jira DC documents the issue collector, "a Jira feedback form into your own website" with no account for the visitor and hidden fields preset; Zammad drove one in batch 3, one generic form for the whole install, which is why its 1.1 is `partial` and this row would be its `yes`. Easy Redmine is `no`: its only embed is a dashboard iFrame widget, the wrong direction. Row 1.1 asks whether a citizen can file on the product's own portal, which is a different question.

pending.name: Can a closed case be archived, hidden from working views and search, read-only, and restored, without being deleted.
pending.dossiqNote: Rated from the source: `archiefstatus` is ZGW data on the zaak, defaulting to `nog_te_archiveren` (`lib/Service/ZgwZrcRulesService.php:121`) and guarded on delete (`lib/Controller/ZrcController.php:1265`, *Archived zaken cannot be deleted without the zaken.geforceerd-verwijderen scope.*). Nothing hides an archived zaak from a list or makes it read-only: the status is a fact about the archive, not a state of the working view. OTOBO and Znuny drove `ticket.archive_flag` in batch 5 and Odoo `action_archive` in batch 6; Jira DC documents "hide it in Jira, but preserve the data it contains", Data Center only, with archive and restore as automation triggers. Easy Redmine is `partial`: a project is archived and "almost completely hidden", a single ticket is closed or deleted. Not 4.20, an export in an archival format, and not 8.7, a destruction date.

pending.name: Does every write path to a date field agree, and does the product show one date for that field.
pending.dossiqNote: Rated from the source, and this is the row that indicts us. **Nine controllers** can set a date on a case: `TermijnController`, `DeadlineReportingController`, `ZrcController`, `DwangsomController`, `ComplaintController`, `ConsultationController`, `AdviceController`, `WOOAssessmentController` and `ContactMomentController`. Ten services carry a deadline in their name, beside `WorkingDayCalculator` and `SlaCalculator`. The only normaliser in the tree is **private**, `normaliseDate()` at `lib/Service/Doorlooptijd/CaseEnricher.php:252`, reachable by one caller. Nothing asserts that the nine writers agree and no test compares them. Gitea is the proof that a correct end-of-day rule, a correct administered time zone and a correct implementation of both, on one of three paths, still shows a caseworker the wrong day. Taiga passes by declining the question: `due_date` is a `DateField`, so there is no time of day and no zone. For dossiq this is an audit instruction before it is a competitive row, and it has been opened as change `one-date-write-path` in dossiq#2697. Batch 12 asks for it to be widened before promotion: Tuleap's write paths agree perfectly and its **read** paths differ by a calendar day on the screen the caseworker uses.

pending.name: Can an administrator define a role and choose its permissions, or only assign a role the product ships.
pending.dossiqNote: Rated from the source. A role type is an **object in a register**, not a constant: `lib/Service/WorkflowStepAuthorizationResolver.php:164-171` resolves `role_type_schema` from settings and looks the role type up through `ObjectService::find()`, and `VthCaseTypeChildSeeder.php:75` seeds `roleTypes` against it. `RoleResolverService` resolves a case's participants against those types with a named strategy (`STRATEGY_SINGLE_ROLE`, `STRATEGY_OR_SET`, `lib/Service/RoleResolverService.php:55-60`). An administrator creates a role type the way they create anything else. The row exists because 13.1, are there application roles, returns `yes` for every system in the corpus with any concept of a role and therefore separates nothing; the question a municipality asks is whether *behandelaar*, *toetser* and *mandaathouder* can exist without a release. Taiga defines roles per project with permissions ticked from a list of 33, verified live; Gitea and Forgejo score `no` on a fixed ladder of read, write and admin, where a team refines which units it holds rather than what a role means.

pending.name: Does the product offer the same configuration vocabulary whichever mode you configure it in, and does it say what you lose.
pending.dossiqNote: A `yes` by absence, and the row is worth carrying for exactly that reason. dossiq has one case-type editor and one configuration surface, so there is no second mode to lose capability in. The shape the row catches is general and we are about to acquire it: any product that grows a basic and an advanced surface over the same objects can strand a buyer between them. Tuleap is the reason the row exists and scores `partial`: the tracker workflow has a simple and an advanced mode, advanced mode makes the transition matrix explicit and **refuses two of the four post actions**, `frozen_fields` and `hidden_fieldsets` both throwing `IncompatibleWorkflowModeException` when `$workflow->isAdvanced()` (`FrozenFieldsJsonParser.php:46`, `HiddenFieldsetsJsonParser.php:47`). Driven: the same `PUT` refused in advanced mode succeeded in simple mode, and the per-transition permissions worked in both. So Tuleap does say what you lose, clearly and by name, at the moment you try, and does not say it when you switch modes, which is when it matters. Huly is `no`: one process editor per master tag, no second mode, and nothing anywhere warns about the consequence of a configuration choice. Rows 11.20 and 11.1 cannot ask this, because neither notices that a product can have two editors over the same objects with different capabilities.

pending.name: When an administrator defines a role, where do its permissions come from, and can a right be removed as well as granted.
pending.dossiqNote: **Unmeasured, and marked so deliberately.** Unlike 8.23 this needs the permission resolver read end to end rather than a grep, and batch 12 had two systems to drive. The interesting half is not whether a role can be defined, which 13.24 already asks and dossiq passes, but whether a right can be taken away: if dossiq's model is additive only, so that a role grants and never removes, this is a `partial` and a real gap. Huly is `yes` and it is the best answer in the corpus: a role is defined on a **master tag**, so roles are per type rather than per application, the permissions it draws from are 52 declared named things rather than a grid (`CreateCardPermission`, `ApproveDocumentPermission`, `RunProcessPermission`, `GuestPermission` and the rest), and roughly a third have a **`Forbid` counterpart**, nine of them, so a role can remove a right the space would otherwise grant. Tuleap is `partial`: an administrator creates a user group per project and grants it anything, which is why 13.24 is `yes`, but the permission set is published nowhere a buyer can read, it is discovered screen by screen, the grants are per object rather than per role, and there is no negative permission.

pending.name: Is the calendar the deadline engine reads the same calendar the organisation administers.
pending.dossiqNote: Measured read-only over `procest/lib` rather than assumed. We have the calendar and it is the best in the corpus: `lib/Service/WorkingDayCalculator.php` administers the Dutch general holidays and **computes Easter itself** rather than calling PHP's `easter_date()`, with a comment explaining why, and nothing in twenty-six driven columns comes close. The row does not ask whether the calendar exists, it asks whether the engine reads it. **37 files do date arithmetic** and **5 reference `WorkingDayCalculator`**: `BackgroundJob/DsoDeadlineJob.php`, `Service/ComplaintService.php`, `Service/DsoCaseService.php`, `Service/Kcc/SlaCalculator.php` and the calculator itself. Thirty-two do not, and three of those are term paths by name: `Service/Beschikking/BezwaarTermijnScheduler.php:76` computes the bezwaar term as `->add(new DateInterval('P6W'))` from the bekendmaking date, `Service/NoticeOfDefaultService.php:171` computes the ingebrekestelling grace as `->modify('+N days')`, and `Service/DeadlinePauseService.php:93` credits a suspension back the same way. Six weeks from bekendmaking is the right term; extending it off a Saturday, a Sunday or a general holiday is what the Algemene termijnenwet requires and what the calculator is for, and these three do not call it. **This is an audit instruction and not a proven defect**: a file doing date arithmetic is not necessarily computing a statutory term, some of the thirty-two are report windows and seed data, and three of the thirty-two were read. What the count establishes is that the calendar is not on the critical path by construction. Huly is `no` and is the first system that could have passed: `PublicHoliday` is a real class with a date and a department and its own screen, and nothing outside HR reads it. Tuleap is `no` for the simpler reason that `opening_days` is a weekday mask with no holiday object at all. Promoted row 8.12 cannot distinguish "no calendar" from "a calendar the engine cannot see", which is a different and worse failure.

pending.name: Transition the person who prepared the case may not make themselves
pending.dossiqNote: Mandaat is modelled and MandaatVerifier reads it, and ConflictOfInterestService asks whether a handler is related to the applicant. No transition carries a negative flag, so nothing stops the person who wrote a decision from approving it.
pending.name_nl: Overgang die de voorbereider van de zaak niet zelf mag zetten

pending.name: Emergency self-granted access, time-boxed, with a reason, enabled per case type
pending.dossiqNote: Row 13.4 grants access, by somebody else, with no reason and no per-case-type switch. sociaalDomeinAuditLog.authorisationGround is declared in the register and has zero readers, so there is no time box, no reason and no access level per case type.
pending.name_nl: Noodtoegang die je jezelf geeft, tijdelijk, met reden, per zaaktype aan te zetten

pending.name: Hand-off refused until consent is recorded, with the sharing scope chosen
pending.dossiqNote: toestemming is declared in the sociaal domein register and the only toestemming hits in lib/ are Dutch error strings. CaseTransferService::initiateTransfer has no consent branch and createPartnerShare writes a share with no scope, so nothing is ever blocked.
pending.name_nl: Overdracht geweigerd tot toestemming is vastgelegd, met gekozen deelomvang

pending.name: Erasure for one person across every case, with a report of what was left
pending.dossiqNote: Rows 8.7 and 13.10 delete on a retention schedule. An erasure request names a person and has to reach identifiers inside message bodies and mail headers, and report honestly what it could not remove.
pending.name_nl: Wissen van één persoon over alle zaken, met een verslag van wat bleef

pending.name: Named role slot on the case, where the right follows whoever occupies it
pending.dossiqNote: Row 5.1 puts parties on a case with roles. Rights are granted to people and groups, not to the slot, so replacing the occupant means editing every grant.
pending.name_nl: Benoemde rolplek op de zaak, waarbij het recht meegaat met de bezetter

pending.name: Destruction proposed as a list, reviewed per item by a named reviewer
pending.dossiqNote: Rows 8.7 and 13.10 destroy on a date. A vernietigingslijst is reviewed item by item by a named reviewer and a co-reviewer, and each response is recorded before anything is destroyed.
pending.name_nl: Vernietiging voorgesteld als lijst, per stuk beoordeeld door een benoemde toetser

pending.name: Anonymising as a configured alternative to deletion, chosen per outcome
pending.dossiqNote: anonymisationAtParts has zero readers, and ArchivalNominationDeriver's whole action vocabulary is bewaren, blijvend_bewaren and vernietigen. There is no anonymise branch to configure.
pending.name_nl: Anonimiseren als ingerichte keuze naast verwijderen, per resultaat gekozen

pending.name: Report accepted without an account, unmasked only by a named custodian
pending.dossiqNote: The Wet bescherming klokkenluiders obliges a municipality to run exactly this surface. Nothing accepts a report against a receipt code, and nothing gates the reveal on a motivated request a custodian answers.
pending.name_nl: Melding zonder account aangenomen, alleen ontsloten door een benoemde vertrouwenspersoon

pending.name: Party relationship granting dated access to the other party's record
pending.dossiqNote: A gemachtigde, a guardian or a parent company should see the record they are entitled to see because of the relationship. Access is granted per case and per user instead.
pending.name_nl: Partijrelatie die gedateerde toegang geeft tot het record van de ander

pending.name: Tamper-evident audit log that can be verified after the fact
pending.dossiqNote: AuditPacketBuilder assembles the beschikking, its immutable transition log and a validation report into a ZIP and stamps it with a sha256 digest, routed at /api/beschikkingen/{id}/audit-pakket. It is a per-beschikking export, not a chained log over the whole trail, and no previousHash exists anywhere.
pending.name_nl: Auditlog waarin knoeien zichtbaar wordt en dat later te controleren is

pending.name: Link type declaring which fields of the linked record it exposes
pending.dossiqNote: Row 2.26 declares typed links. A link is all or nothing, so relating a Wmo case to a Jeugdwet case exposes everything or nothing rather than the two fields that were meant.
pending.name_nl: Koppelsoort die vastlegt welke velden van het gekoppelde record zichtbaar zijn

pending.name: Portal visibility derived from the party tree, so a parent sees its subsidiaries
pending.dossiqNote: Row 13.13 grants portal rights per case. A holding company with eleven subsidiaries is then eleven separate grants, maintained by hand as the group changes.
pending.name_nl: Portaalzicht afgeleid uit de partijboom, zodat een moeder de dochters ziet

pending.name: Notification when a file is downloaded
pending.dossiqNote: Row 13.9 logs a read. lib/Notification holds only the notifier and no download listener is registered, so nothing acts on one while it is happening.
pending.name_nl: Melding zodra een bestand wordt gedownload

pending.name: Permission to hand work to someone, distinct from read and write
pending.dossiqNote: The case schema says of the team that it is assignment, not permission. Reassignment is gated by a coordinator check that resolves to isAdmin, so handing work over is an admin right rather than an axis of its own beside read and write.
pending.name_nl: Recht om werk toe te wijzen, los van lezen en schrijven

pending.name: Row-level access by group, with the inheritance it came from declared
pending.dossiqNote: Rows 13.3 and 13.6 are both partial. Nothing says where a permission came from, and nothing marks one as not inheritable, so an access review cannot be finished.
pending.name_nl: Toegang per rij via groepen, met de herkomst van de overerving erbij

pending.name: Bearer link that opens a case without a login, with expiry and revocation
pending.dossiqNote: CaseSharingService::createTokenShare issues the link and revokeTokenShare withdraws it, both with an expiry. Added so the instrument can record a strength.
pending.name_nl: Deellink die een zaak opent zonder inloggen, met vervaldatum en intrekking

pending.name: Legal hold suspending destruction while a proceeding runs
pending.dossiqNote: LegalHoldApplier, BezwaarLegalHoldListener and AwbProceedingScanner place and lift the hold as a bezwaar or beroep opens and closes. Added so the instrument can record a strength.
pending.name_nl: Bewaarplicht die vernietiging opschort zolang een procedure loopt

pending.name: Bulk reassignment of a departing handler's caseload
pending.dossiqNote: CaseReassignmentService and SelectionReassignmentService move a whole caseload at once, by handler or by selection. Added so the instrument can record a strength.
pending.name_nl: Zaaklast van een vertrekkende behandelaar in bulk herverdelen

pending.name: Case plan of interventions, each with a goal, a provider and a target date
pending.dossiqNote: The register declares gezinsplan.goals and deploymentTrajectories as plain string arrays, with no provider, no target date and no completion mark, and nothing reads them. The schema cannot express the row, so this is no and not partial.
pending.name_nl: Plan van aanpak met interventies, elk met doel, aanbieder en streefdatum

pending.name: Award with amount requested, amount granted, payment, reporting and recovery
pending.dossiqNote: The Subsidie services carry the whole arc: award, interim reporting, final determination, evidence, co-financing and recovery, with the Dwangsom services beside them. Added so the instrument can record a strength.
pending.name_nl: Toekenning met gevraagd bedrag, verleend bedrag, betaling, verantwoording en terugvordering

pending.name: Offline field capture with a visible replay queue and recorded conflicts
pending.dossiqNote: dossiq registers the field-inspection leaf with its own offline config, and the leaf owns the queue and the replay. Its own Dexie store, sync queue engine, replay service and controller were deleted, so conflictRecord has no reader and an inspector still cannot work without a signal.
pending.name_nl: Offline opnemen in het veld met een zichtbare wachtrij en vastgelegde conflicten

pending.name: One instance serving several organisations, with separated data and quotas
pending.dossiqNote: Twenty Tenant services carry it, including TenantSchemaProvisioner, TenantQuotaService and TenantAuditTrailService. Added so the instrument can record a strength.
pending.name_nl: Eén omgeving voor meerdere organisaties, met gescheiden data en quota
